notes: Counts are the Required strength column of the TOE. Positions printed in parentheses are dual designations and are not counted. Officers (O1–O9) and enlisted personnel (EP, E1–E9) are read from the grade rows; civilian employees (SG grades) are shown separately and are not part of personnel totals.
The six elements sum to the regiment totals: officers 34 + 9 + 9 + 11 × 9 + 9 + 9 = 169, EP 87 + 110 + 118 + 11 × 115 + 112 + 21 = 1,713, civilians 6 + 14 + 13 + 11 + 7 + 4 = 55.

Conflict with the earlier PAM 6-0102 (2022) page: that figure also lists a Cyber Battalion. The 2019 TO has no Cyber Battalion; cyber security sits in the Cyber Security Company of the Network Enterprise Technology Battalion. Eleven Signal Battalions agree in both sources.
The HHC counts are calculated from billet rows (Regiment Headquarters 31 officers / 59 EP / 5 civilians, Headquarters Company 3 / 28 / 1), and agree with the printed HHC chart figures of 34 / 87 / 6.

The ASR recap workbook also contains hidden worksheets with older draft figures (for example Command Signal Bn 9 / 151 / 39, Signal Bn 9 / 146 / 6, Signal School 4 / 21 / 8). They disagree with the visible recap and the organizational charts and are not used.

Comparison only · Command IT Company, EW platoon rows in “CITC-CSBN”
sources.locator: 3 Specialty Enablers / 5-ASR / 3 CSBn / 3-CSB_UnitManning.xlsx

notes: (1) is provisionally interpreted as a dual designation following the uploader’s explanation. The document provides no legend, so the interpretation is not confirmed. These entries remain visible but add no extra personnel.
Company headquarters prints TOTAL 4, while eight unparenthesized entries list two officer and six enlisted billets. The discrepancy remains unresolved.
Counting unparenthesized rows gives 5 officer and 36 enlisted billets (41 total). Adding printed group subtotals gives 37. Neither is presented as a confirmed company establishment.

The platoon totals of 11 are calculated from HQ 2 plus three squads of 3. These are required billets under the provisional interpretation, not actual assigned personnel. The Designated Personnel column is blank.
Grade labels 03 and 02 are displayed as O3 and O2 for readability. Designation spacing and obvious typographical errors have been normalized; the original table is preserved in the PDF.

DND-approved PA TO 2019 comparison: the Army Signal Regiment TO has no electronic warfare company and no company with three Electronic Attack / Protection / Support platoons. Its EW elements are an Electronic Warfare Platoon in the Command IT Company, an Electronic Warfare Platoon in the SIM Battalion IT company and an EW Support Platoon in the Electronics company, each with ESM, ECM and ECCM squads and every position in parentheses.

The TO 2019 confirms that a parenthesized (1) is a dual designation that is not added to the TOTAL row. This supports the reading used here, but the supplied company table itself is still unverified: its counts remain provisional and are not replaced by TO 2019 figures.

notes: Counts are the Required strength column of the TOE. Positions printed in parentheses are dual designations and are not counted. Officers (O1–O9) and enlisted personnel (EP, E1–E9) are read from the grade rows; civilian employees (SG grades) are shown separately and are not part of personnel totals.

The TO 2019 confirms the nine-person squad (squad leader, two team leaders, two grenadiers, two automatic riflemen, two riflemen). Three squads per platoon is also confirmed: platoon 36 = headquarters 9 + 27, company 135 = headquarters platoon 27 + 3 × 36.

Resolves the earlier ambiguity: the platoon headquarters row lists two machine gunners and two assistant machine gunners (two two-person crews), a platoon leader, platoon sergeant, assault-weapon gunner, ammunition bearer and radio operator, nine in all. The wording “four machine gun crews” in the 2018 pamphlet is not supported by the TO count.
The combat medic is printed in parentheses in the platoon headquarters, matching the pamphlet’s attached medic. Not counted.
Headquarters section also lists four dual-designated positions (second radio operator, clerk, cook, driver) that add no strength. Reduced strength removes 3 EP, all in the anti-armor section (7 → 4).
